name: 111 Main Street
type: Class A warehouse distribution building (industrial, rear-load)
location: South Amboy, Middlesex County, NJ: Broadway/Main Street redevelopment zone
summary: A 152,100 SF, 36-foot-clear warehouse on a 22-acre site by Woodmont Industrial Partners (with Jingoli), started in May 2022 and delivered with a 96,000 SF lease in January 2026; 25 docks, 23 knockout panels, two drive-ins and a 26-space trailer lot.

leasedSf.label: Leased space

buildingDepthFt.label: Building depth
buildingDepthFt.derivation: The available space is 283'-4" x 195'; warehouse spaces run the full building depth, and 152,100 SF / 195 ft = 780.0 ft exactly, which supports 195 ft as the building depth. The published column bays add up to it: 60 ft speed bay + 3 x 45 ft = 195 ft.

loading.label: Loading configuration
loading.derivation: There is one 60 ft speed bay in the 195 ft depth (60 + 3 x 45), the bay next to a dock wall, so loading is on one long side. The 25 docks, 2 drive-ins and 23 knockouts (50 positions) also fit one 780 ft wall.

endBayFt.label: End column bays
endBayFt.estimate: 780 ft = 12 typical 56'6" bays + two end bays of 51 ft; the real end bays are not published.

eaveHeight.label: Wall height above the warehouse floor
eaveHeight.estimate: 41 ft: the published 36 ft clear plus about 5 ft of roof structure.

dockHigh.label: Dock-high floor above the truck court
dockHigh.estimate: 48 in, the usual dock height; the whole building sits on this datum. Ramps to the drive-in doors are not modelled.

dockDoor.label: Dock door size
dockDoor.estimate: Common dock door size; not published.

dockSpacingFt.label: Dock door spacing
dockSpacingFt.estimate: Centre-to-centre; the 25 docks and 2 drive-ins are set as one run centred on the dock wall. Knockout panels are listed, not modelled.

truckCourtFt.label: Truck court depth
truckCourtFt.estimate: Not published for this building; the 130 ft that Woodmont publishes for Alpha 78 is used.

trailerStall.label: Trailer stall size
trailerStall.estimate: Typical trailer stall; the 26 stalls are laid in one row past the truck court.

carStalls.label: Car parking spaces
carStalls.estimate: The building total is not published ("ample car parking"). The brochure gives 30 striped spaces for the 55,250 SF space; scaled to 152,100 SF that is about 83.

carModule.label: Car parking layout
carModule.value: 9 x 18 ft stalls on a 24 ft aisle, one double-loaded bay along the front wall
carModule.estimate: Typical layout; position on the side opposite the docks is an estimate.

siteShape.label: Site outline
siteShape.value: rectangle of the published 22 acres, the building centred along its long side
siteShape.estimate: No parcel geometry or aerial image was reachable from the build environment, so the outline, the building's position on it and its orientation (docks facing plan south, +z) are schematic. The rectangle leaves at least 30 m around the modelled layout (building, courts, trailer rows, car fields); areas and counts are the published ones.

availableEnd.label: Which end the available space is
availableEnd.estimate: Not published; the 283'-4" available space is put at the plan-east end and the rest of the building is the leased space.

location.label: Location
location.value: Broadway/Main Street redevelopment zone, South Amboy
location.quote: "LOCATED IN THE BROADWAY/MAIN ST. REDEVELOPMENT ZONE IN SOUTH AMBOY, NJ" (leasing site)

columnSize.label: Column size
columnSize.estimate: 12 in square steel column; not published.

wallThickness.label: Exterior wall thickness
wallThickness.estimate: Tilt-up concrete panels are typically 9-12 in; not published.

notes: NJBIZ (May 2022, at groundbreaking) gave 22 dock doors and 22 knock-outs; Real Estate NJ (January 2026, at delivery) and Woodmont's site give 25 docks and 23 knockouts. The delivered numbers are used.
Woodmont's site gives both 152,100 SF and "a 152,000 SF warehouse"; 152,100 SF (also the leasing site and Real Estate NJ) is used.
The leasing site's dock and parking counts (8 docks with 8 knockouts, 1 drive-in, 30 striped spaces) describe the 55,250 SF available space only, not the building.
The 780 ft length leaves the leased space at 780 - 283.33 = 496.67 ft, about 96,850 SF against the published 96,000 SF lease; the difference (about 850 SF) is not explained by the sources.
No street number is published beyond "111 Main St."; the scene carries no geocode.
